A world in either default is accepted only with at least 40 million km² of land and 25 million km² of mild, wet land.

18.1 Custom variants

Built (Variants and Races §2–3). A variant is a folder data/variants/<id>/ with a manifest, races, phonology and morphology presets, naming styles and an RPG profile. The defaults never read it. A variant’s races replace the defaults. Command lines take --variant NAME; generate takes --mode variant:<id>.

Eventide is the first variant: races (human, hynral, doari, tulkata, hadur, karaqa, with IE’s tables kept for checking), the five language presets, three morphology presets, the troll naming style, and the Eventide RPG profile and skills. That this is all data, with no change to the modules' code, is the test of the system, and test/variants.test.ts checks it. In generate, Eventide uses the Creation with its own races, and the first race (human) is the body the hand-off is judged against.
